annotation.title_clean: Regulation No 79 of the Economic Commission for Europe of the United Nations (UN/ECE) — Uniform provisions concerning the approval of vehicles with regard to steering equipment
annotation.title_en: UN/ECE Regulation No 79 — Uniform provisions concerning the approval of vehicles with regard to steering equipment
annotation.authors_or_issuer: UN Economic Commission for Europe (UN/ECE), published in the Official Journal of the European Union
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, L 318/1
annotation.summary_en: UN/ECE Regulation No 79 (03 series of amendments), published in the EU Official Journal, sets uniform type-approval requirements for vehicle steering equipment. It covers driver-assistance steering functions (ACSF categories A, B1, C), corrective and emergency steering, failure and warning provisions, electronic-system safety documentation, and tests. It excludes fully autonomous steering systems.
key_provisions_or_claims: Type approval of steering equipment for vehicle categories M, N and O, with international approval marks and conformity-of-production checks.
Autonomous Steering Systems controlled by off-board signals, and ACSF categories B2, D and E, are excluded from the scope.
Driver must be able to override assistance functions at any time, with override effort not exceeding 50 N.
ACSF Category C lane change requires hands-on detection, rear-vehicle detection of at least 55 m, and suppression in critical situations.
Annex 6 requires safety documentation, fault strategy and verification for complex electronic control systems.
